title.narrative: Guizhou Rocky Desertification Area Water Management Project

description.narrative: The project is aligned with the following impact: livelihoods of people living in rocky desertification areas improved (Guizhou Provincial Government. 2011. Guizhou Provincial Master Plan for Water Resources Development, Ecological Improvement, and Rocky Desertification Management. Guiyang). The project will have the following outcome: rocky desertification area reduced. The project will have two outputs: (i) water resources conserved and (ii) environment, ecology, and land productivity restored.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3564: 91% of contracts awarded and 78% disbursed as of 11 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Strong commitment and support from the Guizhou Provincial Government, the project management offices, project implementation units, and county governments on timely submission of required reports for ADB's review and approval; and implementation of project activities, particularly construction-related activities, according to agreed schedules to achieve outcome by 2025
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48468/48468-002-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Aug 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48468/48468-002-eia-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48468/48468-002-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48468/48468-002-smr-en_15.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Based on midterm review mission conducted during 29 March-2 April 2021, the overall project progress is 34.8% against the elapsed project implementation period of 52.3% as of 31 December 2020. Construction of the Pingqiao Reservoir is estimated to be delayed by 27 months due to (i) delay in the acquisition of the dam site; (ii) delays in the procurements and constructions of temporary diversion tunnel, dam, spillway, and related structures and facilities; and (iii) the optimistic original schedule. The construction of Pingshan Reservoir is estimated to be delayed by 55 months due to (i) delay in updating the domestic resettlement implementation plan and the acquisition of the dam site, and (ii) the optimistic original schedule. The mission updated the overall project implementation schedule. Based on the updated schedule, it is likely that the loan closing date of 31 December 2023 needs to be extended by 2 years to 31 December 2025. The mission strongly informed the Guizhou Provincial Government (including the Finance Department and the project management office [PMO]) and the project implementation units (PIUs) that further delay in the construction of the reservoirs will not be allowed; and if it happens, it may cause the cancellation of the delayed activities and relevant loan amount.
Issue for guidance and recommendation: Closely monitor project implementation based on the updated schedules for project implementation and procurement, and the agreed follow-up actions so that project implementation will not be delayed anymore and the contract award and disbursement will be made in 2021 as agreed upon with the PMO.
Next steps: Update contract award and disbursement projections in eOperations system, and conduct a review mission in early 2022.
